description:
Estimate customs duty, GST and the Customs and MPI goods levy on goods sent or shipped to New Zealand.

    Use for: 'import duty calculator nz', 'how much gst on imports nz',
    'customs charges on a shipment', 'landed cost nz', 'do I pay duty on
    goods from overseas', 'customs goods levy', 'is there duty under $1000'.

    $1,000 OR LESS, CUSTOMS COLLECTS NOTHING (NZ Customs Service): no duty,
    GST or levy unless the item or shipment is valued over NZ$1,000. The
    international freight to New Zealand is NOT part of that value. An
    overseas supplier may already have charged GST at checkout. Same-supplier
    orders arriving the same day count as one shipment. Alcohol and tobacco
    are charged whatever their value and are not covered by this tool.

    NOT FOR LUGGAGE: goods in a traveller's baggage fall under the $700
    traveller allowance and carry neither goods levy. Say so if asked.

    Over $1,000: duty is on the goods value only, not the freight. GST is
    charged on the goods, the freight and insurance, AND the duty. $1,500 of
    goods with $150 freight at 5% duty is $75 duty and $258.75 GST.

    The goods levy (from 1 April 2026, excluding GST) is $51.81 by air or
    post ($7.24 Customs + $44.57 MPI) and $118.44 by sea ($73.87 + $44.57);
    GST is added. By air the example pays $393.33 to Customs. A broker will
    also charge for their services.

    GIFTS are charged like other goods here; Customs sources disagree on a
    gift over $1,000 (see not_modelled), so tell the user to confirm.

    Values are in NZD; there is no currency conversion.

    Args:
        goods_value: Customs value of the goods in NZD, excluding freight.
        freight_insurance: International freight and insurance in NZD.
        duty_rate_percent: Duty rate as a percentage, e.g. 5.
        transport: 'air', 'post' (air rate) or 'sea'. Default 'air'.
        levy_excl_gst: Override the goods levy, NZD excl GST. Omit for the register.

    Returns:
        Whether Customs collects, duty, the GST base, GST, the levy with its
        GST, the total payable to Customs, the landed cost, the sources and
        what is not modelled.
name: nz_import_duty_calculator
